terms.comment: A description of ours: bracchium, the arm, with māchinālis, “of machines”, a word of Pliny’s. No reference work has a word for a robot arm. bracchium robōtī, the robot’s arm, says the same where a robot has been named.

phrases.latin: Vidē quam celeriter bracchium māchināle capsās tollat!
phrases.english: Look how fast the robot arm lifts the boxes!

phrases.latin: In hāc officīnā bracchia māchinālia autoraedās fabricantur.
phrases.english: In this factory robot arms build cars.

sources: Lewis & Short: machinalis · Lewis & Short: bracchium
